nodes.description: Private bool reentrancy lock used by the nonReentrant modifier in ReentrancyGuard.
Public owner address of the Ownable contract, controlling privileged functions.
STQToken instance used to mint tokens to investors.
Address responsible for investment accounting, receiving all payments.
Constant exchange rate of 150000 STQ tokens per ETH.
Constant minimum investment amount of 10 finney.
External mint function of the STQToken interface, mints tokens to an address.
Modifier that toggles rentrancy_lock around the modified function body.
Safe multiplication with overflow assertion.
Safe division helper.
Safe subtraction asserting b <= a.
Safe addition asserting no overflow.
Ownable constructor setting owner to msg.sender.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal owner.
Owner-only function to transfer ownership to a new address.
PreSale constructor validating and storing token and funds addresses.
Payable fallback that requires empty calldata and forwards to buy().
Payable nonReentrant ICO participation entry point that mints STQ and forwards funds.
Constant onlyOwner function returning true.
Caller-controlled address used for investor and owner assignment.
Current block timestamp (now) used to enforce the ICO deadline.
External call m_token.mint(investor, stq) that transfers control to an untrusted token contract.
External call m_funds.transfer(payment) that sends ether to an arbitrary address.

_amount parameter is passed to the external mint call.

newOwner parameter is used to update the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner require check.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
owner is initialized from msg.sender in the Ownable constructor.
Ownable constructor sets the owner state variable.
amIOwner is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
token constructor parameter initializes m_token.
funds constructor parameter initializes m_funds.
token parameter is validated in the STQPreSale constructor.
funds parameter is validated in the STQPreSale constructor.
Fallback forwards execution to the internal buy function.
buy is guarded by the nonReentrant modifier using rentrancy_lock.
rentrancy_lock state variable is read and written by the nonReentrant modifier.
investor local variable is assigned from msg.sender.
investor address is passed as the recipient of the mint external call.
payment local variable is an operand of payment.mul(c_STQperETH).
c_STQperETH constant is an operand of the token amount multiplication.
Arithmetic result of payment.mul is stored in stq.
stq amount is passed as argument to the external mint call.
c_MinInvestment constant is read in the buy require check.
payment amount is forwarded through the m_funds.transfer external call.
m_funds state variable is the target of the external transfer call.
block.timestamp (now) determines the ICO deadline check, creating timestamp dependency.
External mint call executes untrusted token code that could re-enter buy before the reentrancy lock is released.
Ether transfer to m_funds invokes untrusted code that could re-enter buy.
